_help: Folders that hold the retailers' monthly item/sales files (Excel). Every .xlsx in these folders (and sub-folders) is scanned; each file's retailer is recognised from its column headings. Only item details are used (codes, barcode, name, supplier, category): sales quantities and values are never read into the database. Edit the list any time.
_help_ours: Items count as OURS when their supplier (as written in ANY retailer's file) contains one of these texts (capitals don't matter). Re-checked on every run, so new SKUs in next month's files are picked up automatically.
_help_columns: Which column heading holds what, per retailer file. Change a heading here if a retailer renames a column. code, barcode, name and supplier are what matter; category is a list from broad to narrow; month is the month column (newest month wins when an item appears in several files).
